entries.found_by: It failed against the report’s own list.

entries.page_said: Read the 1994 Mirror Group settlement as Maxwell’s company conceding the allegation.

entries.page_said: Placed the cobalt belt in Eastern Congo, and cited children “as young as six” and an old Labor Department count.
entries.replaced_by: Corrected. The cobalt is in the southern Copperbelt (Lualaba and Haut-Katanga); Amnesty’s figure is seven; the 2024 list is 204 goods from 82 countries. Eastern Congo’s documented minerals are tin, tantalum, tungsten and gold.

entries.replaced_by: Corrected. The missing file now counts in neither direction; the conclusion rests on the positive record and is scored against four rivals. The fortune has two documented clients, and the page already said so.

entries.page_said: Connection lines drawn as arrows between places that share only a time, a city or a theme; tunnels labelled as documented with no document; and lines carrying false facts - a 1936 Olympics "awarded to Nazi Germany" (it was 1931), a 2018 World Cup awarded "during Crimea" (2010), BlackRock and Vanguard in "circular ownership", a White House-Capitol tunnel called documented.
entries.replaced_by: Every one of the 481 lines graded 0 (analogy) to 5 (causation) by what the record shows, 440 labels rewritten to state the actual relationship, 19 lines removed - false links, chains with no document, and lines that put living people beside a crime or an agency by placement alone. Arrows survive only where a document carries the direction.
entries.found_by: The edge-tier audit, prompted by an outside review.

entries.page_said: Five psychiatric-hospital markers presented as MKUltra sites (Ionia, Creedmoor, Riverview, Topeka) or as a political-commitment black site (Kasr El Aini), and a villa marker on the wrong street; line ends sitting on the wrong places - CIA lines starting at the National Defense University, Brunel’s MC2 lines ending on the Place de la Concorde obelisk, a trans-Pacific cable landing on Long Island, the Channel Tunnel’s English end in mid-Channel, a Lutnick contact line ending at the World Trade Center site, the Foxconn pin 30 km from the plant.
entries.replaced_by: The six markers and their lines removed: their claims had no source the audit could read, or the source said otherwise (Harold Blauer died at the New York State Psychiatric Institute, which stays on the map). 31 line ends and two pins moved onto the places their labels name. Three more lines removed: an undocumented White House–Capitol tunnel, a Google–Indian Creek line, and a duplicate Derinkuyu–Kaymakli tunnel drawn short of Kaymakli.
entries.found_by: The marker and edge audits; the author’s decision on the held items.

entries.page_said: Stated that the document “proves” AI output channels are manipulated by a background process, and counted a self-concealing pattern as evidence.
entries.replaced_by: Tiered. The outputs and defects are documented; the background process is a hypothesis; the competing explanation - ordinary model error and bias - is stated.

entries.page_said: Listed Jared Kushner’s firm, Affinity Partners, among the resources for moving people underground; carried a Kushner → Saudi PIF → NEOM chain; dated PIF’s $2B to July 2021; gave Affinity as $3B and ~$4.8B; quoted “PR risks” from PIF’s screening panel; stated MBS’s override as fact; kept him on the Indian Creek council “in multiple White House administrations”; called the Moscow session “accredited envoy diplomacy” and Mueller’s review “exhaustive”.
entries.replaced_by: Removed from the relocation passage (no document ties the firm to it) and the NEOM chain cut (no source ties Kushner or Affinity to NEOM). Corrected: June 2021 (Senate Finance); $6.16B under management (Form ADV, March 2026); the panel’s objections and the override attributed to the New York Times via House Oversight letters; on the village council from 2024 to mid-2026; no title on 2 Dec 2025; Mueller left the Gorkov meeting’s purpose disputed. The Indian Creek block no longer reads its residents as a working group.

entries.page_said: The tone pages and the countermeasures drawer said a 20–22 kHz sweep “jams cross-device tracking beacons & acoustic data exfiltration” and was “humidity-adaptive” (nothing in the code reads humidity); labelled tones “Pain Relief”, “Tissue Healing” and “Love / DNA Repair”; claimed “sub-harmonic body-water resonance”; called every tone “ANIMAL-SAFE”; and said the WebRTC and canvas guards protect the reader, when they act only on this site’s own pages.
entries.replaced_by: Each tool now says what it is and nothing about what it does: a fixed 20–22 kHz noise sweep, untested against any beacon and above what most speakers play; sine tones by frequency; binaural beats as two tones one per ear; guards that act on this site only. The names that claimed an effect (healing, protective, shield, sacred) were changed; the addresses were not.
entries.found_by: An outside review, checked against the pages.

entries.where: XVI, XIV, XVII, II, XI, XXIV, XXVI
entries.page_said: The 3 September update printed the US capture of Nicolás Maduro as a killed specimen, “It is not true”; it happened on 3 January 2026. XIV said Göbekli Tepe was “deliberately buried” and that the geological record “confirms” a Younger Dryas impact. XVII said the two governments’ official accounts of the USS Liberty dispute premeditation. II said Israel apologised for Pollard and disbanded the unit, delivered by Shimon Peres, and that no payer had explained what the Epstein money bought. XI called Palantir “CIA-funded”. XXIV said neither 9/11 hijacker was watchlisted, with no date. XXVI gave the player as twelve tracks and eight written entries.
entries.replaced_by: Corrected: Maduro and Cilia Flores captured 3 Jan 2026, indicted in New York, pleading not guilty. Göbekli Tepe’s excavators now attribute the fill to slope slides; the impact hypothesis is contested. Neither government’s official account found premeditation, and the dissent is inside the US record. Israel called Pollard a “rogue operation”, then in 1998 acknowledged him as a Lekam agent; no apology or disbandment was found. Black’s and Dechert’s explanations are on the record, and what is unexplained is the scale. In-Q-Tel is a documented early Palantir shareholder. Not put forward for a watchlist until 21–23 August 2001. Eighteen tracks on the player and nine written entries.
entries.found_by: The page errors on file, and an outside review.
